source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The callback retains the Locked feature restriction but always supplies PoliciesUtils.setDefaultPref to the comm proxy helper. That helper does not read Locked and calls its setter with name/value only. The current proxy test has no explicit Locked:true case. These are forwarding and test-scope facts; the separate Gecko setter and native locking behavior are unpaired and unexecuted, so no runtime lost-lock result is claimed.
title: Proxy feature restriction and preference setter selection remain separate source paths
